name: Insulin
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Binds the insulin receptor: increases glucose uptake in muscle and fat, suppresses hepatic glucose output and ketogenesis, shifts potassium into cells

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

dosing.h: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) and Hyperosmolar Hyperglycaemic State (HHS)

items.t: Insulin, short-acting, IV infusion, 50 units in 200 mL sodium chloride 0.9%. · 4 mL solution = 1 unit insulin. · Initial infusion: 0.1 unit/kg/hour.

dosing.h: Severe Hyperglycaemia (Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) & Hyperosmolar Hyperglycaemic State

items.t: Insulin, short acting, IM, 0.1 unit/kg. · When giving insulin IM, do not use insulin needle.
Insulin, short acting, IM, 0.1 units/kg after 1st hour of infusion of saline · When giving insulin IM, do not use insulin needle.

adjustments.t: Safe – treatment of choice in pregnancy

cautions.t: Soluble (short-acting) insulin is the only type given IV
Correct potassium before and during infusion in DKA

monitoring.t: Blood glucose hourly on infusion, potassium
